# The browser block with browser-automation = true (this run's own config).
size:1280x800
wait:0.5
browser:open @SITE@/index.html ==> @SITE@
page-wait:go
expect-tab:Probe Home
expect-page:Home page
browser:url ==> /index.html
browser:text ==> Home page
# Typing and clicking in the page.
browser:type #name | Libertty ==> 
browser:click #go ==> 
browser:eval document.getElementById('out').textContent ==> Hello, Libertty
browser:click #nothing-here ==> !nothing matches
# Links, history, a new-window link staying here.
browser:click #next ==> 
wait:0.8
expect-tab:Second
browser:back ==> 
wait:0.8
expect-tab:Probe Home
browser:forward ==> 
wait:0.8
expect-tab:Second
browser:back ==> 
wait:0.8
browser:click #popup ==> 
wait:0.8
expect-tab:Second
# The address bar: an address without its scheme, and back home.
bar:@HOST@/index.html
wait:0.8
expect-tab:Probe Home
browser:screenshot @OUT@/browser-shot.png ==> browser-shot.png
expect-shell:test -s @OUT@/browser-shot.png && echo yes ==> yes
shot:browser.png
